findings.text: assert worker["pid"] == pid compares the pid the call returned against the record the same call wrote, so it holds whenever the function is internally consistent and observes nothing independent; the load-bearing arm is pid > 0 at :226.

the finally hands pid to os.kill; if the launch path ever returns 0, kill(0, SIGTERM) signals the test's whole process group instead of a helper process, so a red arm on that path aborts the pytest session rather than failing one case.
the unreadable-stamp fallback branch has no case: reverting it to an order-only comparison leaves the green arm green, so the preserved difference test the repair's prose promises is unpinned.
